name: local-remote-control-demo
description: LAN-only macOS remote screen view and control (ScreenCaptureKit streaming + browser client).

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p .build && swiftc native/agent.swift -o .build/agent -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework CoreMedia -framework VideoToolbox && swiftc native/permission_guide.swift -o .build/permission-guide -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices
